observation.visible_scene: An overhead/angled view of a floor covered with long serpentine chains of standing plastic dominoes sorted by color: red and blue chains on a lighter wooden section at the left, a green loop at the far left edge, and large yellow and orange chains on a darker brown floor section to the right and bottom. A white wall-mounted radiator and a small white electrical outlet are visible along the top wall.
visible_changes: The domino chains remain upright and in the same relative arrangement throughout the excerpt; no toppling or chain reaction is observed within these frames.

The framing drifts gradually: the wall outlet and the radiator shift position toward the upper-left of the frame over time, and the green loop at the left edge and the orange loop at the bottom edge move partly out of view, indicating a slow camera pan/zoom rather than object motion.
A few already-flat pieces (e.g. a pinkish/orange domino lying down inside the bottom orange loop) stay flat and unchanged, showing they fell before this segment began.
outside_clip_unknowns: Any trigger, contact, or earlier impact that may have started a fall, and any collapse that may occur after the last frame, are not shown.
The cause of the pre-existing flat dominoes is not visible.
uncertain_details: The exact direction and magnitude of the camera movement (pan vs. zoom) cannot be pinned down from the background alone.
Whether any individual domino is at the very start of a fall is not resolvable; all chains appear static.
